description: c3844 universal alpha-mode capture: boots straight into the NORMAL scrolling Perfect Dark credits via the --launch-credits fast-path (mainChangeToStage(STAGE_CREDITS=0x5c) WITHOUT creditsRequestAltTitle, so creditsReset leaves slidesenabled=true and the credit slides render from frame 0 -- the alt-title path starts solid-black with slides disabled and was the original black-screen bug). Captures four screenshots spaced across the credits scroll to picture-prove the credits' transparent particles (up to 500 G_RM_XLU_SURF particles, alpha-blended background gradient layers via creditsChooseBgColours/creditsDrawBackgroundLayer, and the alpha framebuffer fade in creditsFillFramebuffer) plus the Handel Gothic credit fonts (g_FontHandelGothicLg/Md/Sm selected per CREDITSTYLE_* in creditsDrawSlide -> creditsDrawForegroundText). install_state=current reuses the existing extracted install so the credits load within a few seconds of boot rather than waiting on a clean re-extract; --no-net keeps the firewall focus-steal class out and --no-sound keeps the run quiet. The first credit slide is visible immediately (first slide loadat is ~6s+) and the full roll lasts well over a minute, so all four captures (8/16/24/32s) land on live credit-slide content, not the post-credits black/wordmark scroll. Scripted exit at 44s, well after the four captures. Verifies the c3844 alpha-mode fix renders the credits' transparent fonts/particles without an access violation or fatal.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: --launch-credits enters the normal scrolling credits (mainChangeToStage(STAGE_CREDITS=0x5c) + setNumPlayers(1) + bond/coop/anti seeding + lvSetDifficulty(DIFF_A), NO creditsRequestAltTitle) once from bootApplyCliFastPaths after catalog init -- the same lifecycle point bootApplyMainMenu/bootApplyLaunchMission fire. On a warm install the credits stage loads within a few seconds; the credit slides (Handel Gothic fonts + XLU particles) scroll on their own from frame 0, no player input required. --skip-intro is overridden by the direct mainChangeToStage so the attract loop is never entered.
scripted exit at 44s -- after all four scroll captures (8s/16s/24s/32s). modmgr: shutdown on exit produces the SMOKE: result=scripted_exit sentinel.
